people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

translations.web: But when the cloud began to arise up out of the city in a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them; and behold, the whole city went up in smoke to the sky.
translations.bsb: But when the column of smoke began to go up from the city, the Benjamites looked behind them and saw the whole city going up in smoke.
translations.kjv: But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the flame of the city ascended up to heaven.
translations.asv: But when the cloud began to arise up out of the city in a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them; and, behold, the whole of the city went up in smoke to heaven.
